quotes.text: 3 Por responsabilidades familiares permanentes (cuidado de niños o personas dependientes)

assessments.reasoning: The supplied instrument [C] cuestionario-ene-2020.pdf does not include a separate domestic or care work module. Unpaid care work is only mentioned as a reason for inactivity or for not working additional hours (e.g., j7 option 3 and h16 option 5), treating care responsibilities as a reason for not seeking work or for working fewer hours rather than measuring unpaid domestic and care work directly.
